recipe_version.title: Swedish Meatballs in Cream Gravy with Lingonberry and Dill Potatoes
recipe_version.description: Tender beef and pork meatballs scented with allspice, browned in butter and simmered in a silky cream gravy with a touch of Dijon, served with boiled potatoes tossed in dill and a spoonful of tart lingonberry jam.

steps.title: Mix and roll
steps.body: Put the potatoes in the 6- to 8-quart pot with 12 cups cold water and 2 tsp salt and set over high heat. Soak the panko in the milk 3 minutes, then mix in the egg, grated onion, allspice, 1 tsp salt, pepper, beef, and pork just until combined. Roll into 24 balls about 1 1/4 inches across.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.body: Boil the potatoes until tender, about 20 minutes, while the meatballs and gravy cook in steps 3 to 5 (overlap stated). Drain and toss with half the dill.

steps.title: Brown the meatballs
steps.body: Melt 2 tbsp butter in a 12-inch skillet over medium. Brown the meatballs on all sides, turning, 10 minutes. Transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Make the gravy
steps.body: Melt 2 tbsp butter in the skillet, whisk in the flour, and cook 1 minute. Whisk in the stock gradually, then the cream and Dijon, and simmer until it coats a spoon, 5 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer and serve
steps.body: Return the meatballs and juices to the gravy and simmer on low until 160 F in the center, 8 minutes. Serve with the dill potatoes, a spoonful of lingonberry jam, and the remaining dill.
